description.text: A special expansion of the BW series released on 27 January 2012, in which every card is holo and every Pokémon is a Dragon. It introduced the Dragon type, a tenth type beside the nine before it, led by a powerful Rayquaza. Packs held five holo cards, and the cards are numbered to 20. Many of its cards were reprinted in English in Dragon Vault, another small all-holo set, in October 2012.
